title: Pricing
content: AgentDesk AI offers a starter plan for small businesses, a growth plan for teams, and an enterprise plan for custom integrations.

title: Integrations
content: AgentDesk AI can integrate with websites, WhatsApp, email, CRM systems, and internal knowledge bases.

title: Activation Support
content: If a customer has paid but their account is not active, apologize and escalate to human support.

title: Demo Booking
content: For high-intent leads, ask them to book a 30-minute demo.
